_README: Every number here is an INPUT to the Gate 0 unit-economics model. Each carries a `src` field: an assumption ID (A#), a source key from sources.md, or the literal string 'TODO-RESEARCH' while it is still unfilled. Nothing in this file is a fact unless `src` points at sources.md. Edit this file and re-run `node docs/homie-coffee/model/unit-economics.mjs` to recompute every table in doc 05.

vat._note: Omnomnom sp. z o.o. is NOT a VAT payer from 2026-01-01 (F12). Two consequences are modelled: (1) it charges no VAT, so its shelf price IS its net revenue; (2) it CANNOT reclaim input VAT, so VAT paid on coffee, packaging, shipping and fees is a real cost. Both need accountant confirmation.

coffeeInputVatRate.note: VAT rate on roasted coffee in PL

exemptionThreshold.note: turnover limit before VAT registration is forced

wholesaleResale.label: Wholesale resale of an existing roaster's product

founderHourlyOpportunityCost.note: Set to 0 to see cash-only margin; set to a real rate to see whether the founder's time is being destroyed.

b2cParcelPriceCharged.note: what the customer pays below the free threshold

freeShippingThreshold.note: market norm; the model solves for the viable one

b2b._note: A3 correction: a warm channel is NOT zero-CAC. Sales labour, samples, discounts, delivery and account management are costed explicitly here.

validationBudgetCeilings._note: A2. Scenario ceilings, NOT committed budgets. The rejected 40-60k PLN figure must never reappear.
